name: Example HVAC AixLib Complex Project
description: Complex hydraulic simulation example with AixLib backend, based on the DigitalHub IFC. Uses a lowered fuzzy threshold to reduce the number of decisions. IFC path should be updated to match your local repository location.
notes: Based on examples/e2_complex_project_hvac_aixlib.py. The fuzzy_threshold setting is IFC-specific and was chosen to reduce the number of decisions for this particular building; it may need re-evaluation for other IFC files. The weather_file_path is relative to the bim2sim package root and resolved automatically.
